text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then came the Nikkei Sho. Narita 
Taishin returned once more to the grounds 
of Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could run like I did in the 
Satsuki Sho—but what if it turns out like 
the Kikuka Sho—?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer encouraged and inspired Narita 
Taishin, who was weighed down by anxiety.
